cardSettingsDescription: This switch controls the entire membership requirement across subscription purchases and renewals.
description: Control whether membership is required, then configure the membership card and its policies.
disabledDescription: After saving, membership expiry is no longer checked for subscription purchases or renewals. All membership policies are paused, while existing expiry dates and orders are retained.
enabledDescription: When disabled, users can purchase and renew subscriptions without membership checks, and all membership policies are paused.
name: Name
nameRequired: Please enter a membership card name

policy.description: Choose which monthly limits apply to active members when they purchase, renew, or reset subscription traffic.
policy.monthlyConsumptionHint: Counts pending, paid, and completed subscription orders.
policy.monthlyOrdersHint: Limits the number of subscription orders a member can create each month.
policy.subscriptionExpiryHint: Block subscription purchases or renewals when the resulting expiry is beyond the membership expiry plus the allowed days.
policy.title: Abuse Prevention Policies

previewDescription: The membership card configuration retained for the user experience.
priceDescription: This is the price for one full membership card period, not a monthly unit price.
title: Membership Management

validation.description: The membership description cannot exceed 5,000 characters.
validation.durationValue: Duration must be an integer from 1 to 1,000.
validation.monthlyConsumption: The monthly consumption limit must be greater than zero when enabled.
validation.monthlyOrders: The monthly order limit must be greater than zero when enabled.
validation.name: The membership name must contain 1 to 255 characters.
validation.price: Price must be a valid amount from 0 to 20,000,000.00.
validation.subscriptionExpiryGraceDays: Allowed extra days must be an integer from 0 to 36,500.
